components.evidence_level: Public source patch prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: Full local hub check suite and kit freshness passed on the release candidate with gateway v0.1.0-alpha.6, Linux SDK v0.1.0-alpha.4, ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.8 and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.4. The simulator kit is rebuilt from gateway v0.1.0-alpha.6. ADR 005 decides the Wi-Fi route. On 12 October the owner's ESP32-S3 OLED kit passed physical acceptance over Wi-Fi from a USB charger, and Grok Bot showed text on it through local shell execution; native Grok Bot MCP calls are not claimed.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; Wi-Fi device listener used by one physical kit; Grok Bot local-command route observed
components.checks: 193 tests on Python 3.11 (LAN tests also on 3.12-3.14), Ruff, package builds and the demo passed. Adds the opt-in LAN TLS device listener, local CA, lan-cert, lan-ca, wifi-provision and LAN request-log events. On 12 October the owner's ESP32-S3 OLED kit passed Wi-Fi acceptance through it (ESP32 SDK docs/verification/oled-kit-wifi-2026-10-12.md). Native Grok Bot MCP calls and the tunnel route are not verified.
54 tests, Ruff, package builds and the README quick start passed. The gateway integration used v0.1.0-alpha.4 with mcp 2.3.0. No fresh Linux container, systemd or Raspberry Pi run in this release.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; four firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: tools/check.sh host suites (including wifi_console and wifi_link), the four firmware builds (atoms3-lite-usb, esp32s3-led-button, esp32s3-oled-kit, esp32s3-oled-kit-wifi) and the contract transcripts passed. On 12 October 2026 the owner observed the Wi-Fi build on a USB charger: connect on boot, text and clear, BOOT events, Wi-Fi loss and recovery (after the rejoin fix), gateway restart, revoke and re-enroll, wrong-CA rejection and power cycle (docs/verification/oled-kit-wifi-2026-10-12.md). One kit; not independently reproduced.
27 tests, Ruff and package builds passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.
